detail: Full summary: structural fix for plugin-bundled vs project-pinned dual twining servers — exact-command deny is inherently fragile and per-repo. Candidates: server-side single-instance guard per project (second instance detects dashboard port/lock, skips dashboard, or exits cleanly), or upstream env expansion in plugin .mcp.json (anthropics/claude-code#9427). v2.1 design territory alongside #32/#33.
